summary: Completed Phase 8a/8b testing: Square OAuth integration + File Management. 19/21 tests passed. Square OAuth endpoints correctly handle 'not configured' state. File management works correctly for normal operations. Found 2 backend bugs and 1 documentation issue.

critical_bugs.issue: Returns 500 instead of 413 when uploading oversized file (>15 MB). MongoDB rejects with 'Resulting document after update is larger than 16777216' error.
critical_bugs.root_cause: Backend checks file size correctly (line 1538 in wrecker.py), but MongoDB has a 16MB document size limit. When the entire job document (including the file) exceeds 16MB, MongoDB raises WriteError which bubbles up as 500 instead of being caught and returned as 413.
critical_bugs.impact: Users get generic 500 error instead of helpful 'file too large' message
critical_bugs.suggested_fix: Wrap the db.tow_jobs.update_one() call in try/except to catch pymongo.errors.WriteError and return HTTPException(413, 'File too large - MongoDB document size limit exceeded')

critical_bugs.issue: Returns 422 validation error instead of 404 when no Square connection exists. Error: 'Field required' for query parameter 'body'.
critical_bugs.root_cause: FastAPI routing/validation issue - endpoint expects JSON body but validation error suggests it's looking for query parameter. Needs investigation.
critical_bugs.impact: Cannot test the 'not connected' error path for location endpoint
critical_bugs.suggested_fix: Investigate FastAPI routing configuration. Endpoint signature looks correct: async def set_location(body: LocationIn, user=Depends(require_admin))

documentation_issues.issue: States 'All passwords: HighwayPilot2026!' but wrecker accounts use different passwords
documentation_issues.impact: Test scripts fail to authenticate as wrecker users
documentation_issues.suggested_fix: Update test_credentials.md to document wrecker-specific passwords or standardize all demo passwords to HighwayPilot2026!
